One day the market stalls are piled with bangles, bindis and karwa pots, and the next you are sitting with fresh mehendi on your hands, waiting for the evening moon. Phones are already filling with greetings from mothers-in-law, sisters, friends and colleagues. Karwa Chauth falls on Thursday, October 29, 2026, in India. Puja and moonrise timings vary by city, and some calendars list October 28, so please check your local panchang.
